real_fps.data: OpenCV samples/data/vtest.avi (real pedestrians, 768x576 @ 10 fps, no theft labels)
real_fps.note: zones are the example store's, so events on this street scene are meaningless; FPS only

p_pick_detected.source: UPPER BOUND. MERL Shopping test split (28 real videos, overhead camera): share of 589 labelled reaches where our pose model put a wrist in the shelf zone. A pick also needs the product detected, which MERL can't measure (its products aren't COCO classes).

pick_conf_mean.source: not measured: no labelled real data for this yet

p_false_pick_on_touch.source: not measured: no labelled real data for this yet

p_putback_detected.source: not measured: needs store footage with these events labelled (pilot shadow mode or staged session)

p_conceal_detected.source: PoseLift (real store, Apache-2.0), 5-fold by video x 3 seeds: 34/123 held-out shoplifting clips where the classifier (threshold 0.5) triggered inside the labelled interval.

p_false_conceal.source: RetailS normal footage (36.4 h, real shoppers, evaluation only): share of 2448 person tracks (>= 2 s) with a classifier trigger at threshold 0.5. The simulator applies it per carried item, so this is a per-shopper stand-in.

p_category_confusion.source: not measured: needs store footage with these events labelled (pilot shadow mode or staged session)

p_crowd_candidates.source: not measured: no labelled real data for this yet

p_crowd_swap.source: not measured: needs store footage with these events labelled (pilot shadow mode or staged session)

p_visible_at_exit.source: not measured: needs store footage with these events labelled (pilot shadow mode or staged session)

p_false_held_at_exit.source: not measured: no labelled real data for this yet

p_register_visit_detected.source: not measured: needs store footage with these events labelled (pilot shadow mode or staged session)

p_exit_detected.source: not measured: needs store footage with these events labelled (pilot shadow mode or staged session)

p_id_switch.source: MERL test split: share of single-shopper videos (~2 min each) whose shopper got more than one track id. Overhead view, harder than an angled ceiling camera, so likely pessimistic for a real store.

p_id_swap.source: not measured: no labelled real data for this yet

p_pos_dropped.source: not measured: needs the operator's POS export

pos_jitter_s.source: not measured: needs the operator's POS export

merl_measure.source: MERL Shopping Dataset, test subjects 27-41 (real video, overhead lab store, 1 shopper/video)
merl_measure.license: MERL research dataset (see data/LICENSES.md): evaluation only

conceal_poselift.final_model: models/conceal_poselift.pt (all PoseLift videos; do not evaluate it on PoseLift)

conceal_retails.dataset: RetailS (TeCSAR-UNCC), evaluation only, no license stated
conceal_retails.trigger_rule: >= 8 consecutive frames over threshold per track, merged within 10 s, 15 fps

speed.note: TensorRT needs an NVIDIA GPU (A100 / Jetson); not measurable on this machine.
